caseName: Chicago, Milwaukee & St. Paul Railway Co. v. Board of Railroad Commissioners
caseNameFull: Chicago, Milwaukee & St. Paul Railway Company v. Board of Railroad Commissioners of the State of South Dakota
attorneys: Mr. J. N. Davis, with whom Messrs. O. W. Dynes, E. L. Grantham, H. H. Field, and Frank K. Nebeker, were on the brief, for plaintiff in error. Mr. Raymond L. Dillman for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the

want of jurisdiction upon the authority of McCain v. Des Moines, 174 U. S. 128,181; Western Union Telegraph Company v. Ann Arbor R. R. Co., 178 U. S. 239, 243; Spencer v. Duplan Silk Company, 191 U. S. 526, 530; Shulthis v. McDougal, 225 U. S. 561, 569; Hull v. Burr, 234 U. S. 712, 720; Norton v. Whitesides, 239 U. S. 144, 147.
